monsters.name: #089 The Embodiment of Chaos
monsters.subtitle: Changes (Size and Creature Type Change; see traits), Chaotic Evil
monsters.description:
Armor Class: 25 (Natural Armor)

Initiative: +7 (17)

Hit Points: 700 (40d20 + 280)

Speed: 30 ft., swim 30 ft., climb 30 ft., fly 30 ft. (hover)

STRDEXCONINTWISCHA
25 (+7)25 (+7)25 (+7)25 (+7)25 (+7)25 (+7)
Save +7Save +16Save +16Save +7Save +16Save +7

Skills: Perception +16

Resistances: See Chaotic Form

Immunities: Force; Poisoned, Charmed, Frightened, Paralyzed, Petrified, Exhaustion

Senses: Truesight 120 ft., Passive Perception 26

Languages: -

Challenge Rating: 30 (155,000 XP), Proficiency Bonus: +9

Gear: None

Environment: Planar (Any Chaotic Plane)

Traits

Chaotic Form: At the start of each turn, roll to change creature type and size. If there's insufficient space for the new size, adjust accordingly. Resistances granted per type:

    1: Aberration (Psychic)

    2: Beast (None)

    3: Construct (Bludgeoning, Piercing, Slashing)

    4: Dragon (Roll on Chaos Bolt table)

    5: Elemental (Choose two: Fire, Cold, Piercing, Slashing, Acid, Bludgeoning)

    6: Fey (Psychic)

    7: Fiend (Fire, Necrotic, Poison)

    8: Giant (Choose one: Fire, Lightning, Bludgeoning)

    9: Monstrosity (Choose two: Bludgeoning, Piercing, Slashing)

    10: Ooze (Acid)

    11: Plant (None)

    12: Undead (Necrotic)

Size (1d6): Tiny, Small, Medium, Large, Huge, Gargantuan

Legendary Resistance (5/Day): Succeed on a failed saving throw.

Chaotic Legendary Resistance: Roll a d20 when using Legendary Resistance:

    1: Fails, use expended

    2-19: Works as normal

    20: Succeeds without expending a use

Chaos Ready: When rolling initiative, can react to cast Chaos immediately.

Concentration Master: Can concentrate on two spells at once. Advantage on concentration saving throws.

Magic Resistance: Advantage on saves against spells and magical effects.

Magical Attacks: Attacks are considered magical.

Chaos Magic: When casting spells, roll twice on Wild Magic table; choose the better result.

Shifting Master: Defensive Shift doesn't require reaction.

Incorporeal Movement: Can move through creatures and objects. If ending turn inside an object, shunted to nearest open space.

Actions

Multiattack: The Embodiment makes four Chaos Burst attacks, or three and casts a spell.

Chaos Burst: Melee or Ranged Attack: +16 to hit, reach 5 ft. or range 60 ft., one target.
Hit: 33 (4d12 + 7) damage of a type determined by current creature type:

    Aberration or Fey: Psychic

    Beast: Piercing

    Construct, Giant, Monstrosity, Plant: Bludgeoning

    Dragon or Elemental: Roll on Chaos Bolt table

    Ooze: Acid

    Undead: Necrotic

Innate Spellcasting: Spellcasting ability is Intelligence (spell save DC 24, +16 to hit).
At will: Chaos, Chaos Bolt, Sorcerous Burst, Chromatic Orb

Reactions

Unerring Revenge: When the Embodiment takes more than 20 damage in one turn from a creature within 5 ft., it automatically hits that creature with a Chaos Burst attack.

Defensive Shift: When targeted by an effect that references size or creature type (e.g., Divine Smite, grapple conditions), it immediately shifts its form according to Chaotic Form. For grapples, shifts before resolution.

Legendary Actions (3/round)

Blast: Make one Chaos Burst attack.

Chaos: Cast Chaos, or if already concentrating on it, roll on Chaos's table.

Shape Shift: Shift form as described in Chaotic Form trait.

monsters.name: Rat Warlord
monsters.subtitle: Medium Humanoid, Chaotic (Neutral or Evil) or Neutral Evil
monsters.description:
Armor Class: 17 (Studded Leather)

Initiative: +5 (15)

Hit Points: 210 (20d8 + 120)

Speed: 30 ft., swim 20 ft., climb 20 ft.

STR DEX CON INT WIS CHA
14 (+2) 21 (+5) 22 (+6) 6 (-2) 11 (+0) 15 (+2)
Save +2 Save +10 Save +11 Save -2 Save +0 Save +2

Skills: Stealth +10, Persuasion +7, Deception +7, Intimidation +12

Immunities: Poison; Charmed, Frightened, Paralyzed, Poisoned

Senses: Darkvision 60 ft., Passive Perception 15

Languages: Common, plus two other languages

Challenge Rating: 13 (10,000 XP), Proficiency Bonus: +5

Gear: Studded Leather, Daggers (2), Sling, Pipes of the Sewers

Environment: Urban

Traits

Universal Rat Charmer: Pipes of the Sewers affect giant rats and wererats (in any form). Humanoid-form wererats must succeed on a DC 15 Wisdom save or be affected.

Rat Lord: Saves to resist the pipes are at disadvantage. No half-mile limit or charge restriction. Range is 60 ft.

Supreme Rat Rallying: Swarms summoned are Large and have double HP.

Super Charming: Creatures have disadvantage on saving throws against charm effects from the warlord.

Legendary Resistance (3/day): If the warlord fails a saving throw, it can choose to succeed instead.

Sewer Strikes: Weapon damage includes +6 (1d12) poison damage that ignores resistance.

Rat's Crawl: Speed is not halved while crawling.

Too Commanding: Charmed creatures act during the warlord's turn.

Rats Ready: If the warlord has any rat-like creature charmed, it has advantage on initiative rolls.

Actions

Multitask: Makes 2 dagger or sling attacks, then begins/maintains pipes of the sewers, then commands all charmed creatures to attack.

Dagger: Melee or Ranged Weapon Attack, +10 to hit, reach 5 ft. or range 20/60 ft., Hit: 15 (2d4 + 10) piercing + 6 (1d12) poison.

Sling: Ranged Weapon Attack, +10 to hit, range 30/120 ft., Hit: 15 (2d4 + 10) bludgeoning + 6 (1d12) poison.

Spellcasting: 3rd-level bard (spell save DC 15, +7 to hit).

  • Cantrips:
    • Vicious Mockery, Friends
  • 1st Level (4):
    • Charm Person, Animal Friendship, Command, Bane
  • 2nd Level (2):
    • Animal Messenger, Suggestion

    Reactions

    Swarm's Revenge: When a controlled swarm takes damage, it moves to the attacker and makes a bite attack.

    Swarm: When a creature ends its turn within 60 ft., all charmed creatures swarm it and one attacks.

    Legendary Actions (2/round)

    Befriend: Casts Friends, Charm Person, Suggestion, or Animal Friendship.

    Dagger: Makes a dagger attack; on hit, adds 6 (1d12) poison damage.

    Poison: Makes a dagger attack; on hit, the target is poisoned until end of its next turn instead of taking poison damage.

    Bonus Actions

    Rat's Nimbleness: The warlord takes two of the following actions: Disengage, Hide, Dash, Dodge.

    Lair

    The Rat Warlord resides in the sewers of a large city, such as Waterdeep. In their lair, the warlord is CR 15 (13,000 XP).

    Lair Actions (Initiative Count 20)

    Infestation: Casts Infestation on any number of targets; 4d6 damage, half on save.

    Nature's Onslaught: Casts this homebrew spell, damage is all piercing except bludgeoning on poor saves.

    Mass Command: All controlled rats/wererats make one attack. Cannot be repeated consecutively.

    Regional Effects

    Sewers within 5 miles teem with rats, giant rats, and possible wererats.

    No plant growth or non-rat animal life exists in those sewers.

    The nearby city is filthy and trash-strewn.

monsters.name: Demon King Ganondorf
monsters.subtitle: Large Humanoid, Chaotic Evil
monsters.description:
Armor Class: 23 (Gerudo armor)

Hit Points: 652 (64d10 + 300)

Speed: 60 ft.

STR DEX CON INT WIS CHA
12 (+1) 30 (+10) 30 (+10) 18 (+4) 2 (-4) 9 (-1)

Saving Throws: Str +9, Wis +1, Cha +0

Damage Vulnerabilities: Slashing from the Master Sword, Radiant

Damage Immunities: Poison, Necrotic

Damage Resistances: Bludgeoning, Piercing, Slashing from nonmagical attacks

Condition Immunities: Poisoned, Charmed, Frightened, Paralyzed

Senses: Blindsight 100 ft., Passive Perception 10

Languages: Common, Gerudo

Challenge Rating: 27 (105,000 XP)

Traits

Legendary Resistance (3/day): If Ganondorf fails a saving throw, he can choose to succeed instead.

Magic Resistance: Advantage on saving throws against spells and magical effects.

Supreme Dodging: Ganondorf has the feats Perfect Dodge and Pristine Dodge.

Innate Spellcasting: Can cast the following spells as bonus actions:

  • At will: Summon Magic Weapon (as a 9th level spell; cannot choose handaxe; can summon Demon King's Bow)
  • At will: Darkness

Gloomy Fighter: Necrotic damage reduces a target's maximum HP until they are exposed to sunlight, receive a greater restoration spell, or drink a greater/superior healing potion.

Actions

Multiattack: Ganondorf makes 3 attacks, then 1 moving action.

Shortsword: +15 to hit, reach 10 ft., 4d6 necrotic damage

Spear: +6 to hit, reach 15 ft., 4d6 necrotic damage

Great Club: +6 to hit, reach 10 ft., 4d8 necrotic damage

Demon King's Bow: +15 to hit, range 150/600 ft., 4d12 necrotic damage

Eat Magic Stone: Transforms into Demon Dragon Ganondorf.

Create Clones: Summons 6 clones with 100 HP, AC 18. Clones cannot speak, cast spells, eat the magic stone, create clones, or take moving actions.

Moving Actions

Spin Attack (shortsword only): Hits all within 10 ft. at advantage. Area becomes gloomed; creatures entering it take 1d6 necrotic damage until next turn.

Spear Dash (spear only): Dashes 50 ft. Creatures within 10 ft. of path make DC 16 Dex save. Fail: 2d6 necrotic + 9d8 piercing. Success: half piercing, no necrotic. Trail becomes gloomed, same effect.

Club Slam (great club only): All within 60 ft. make DC 18 Dex save. Fail: 5d6 necrotic. Success: half. Area becomes gloomed, same effect.

Bonus Actions

Dodge: The next attack against Ganondorf has disadvantage.

Legendary Actions (3 per round)

Attack (2 actions if using bow): Makes one weapon attack.

Move: Moves up to half speed, ignoring opportunity attacks.

Reactions

Retaliation (not with bow): If a creature within 30 ft. deals more than 50 damage in one turn, Ganondorf may move up to his speed and make an attack against that creature.

monsters.name: Minotaur Barbarian
monsters.subtitle: Medium Monstrosity
monsters.description:
Armor Class: 14

Hit Points: 90

Speed: 40 ft.

STR DEX CON INT WIS CHA
20 (+5) 10 (+0) 16 (+3) 6 (-2) 14 (+2) 8 (-1)

Skills: Perception +7

Senses: Darkvision 60 ft., Passive Perception 17

Languages: Common

Proficiency Bonus: +3

Challenge Rating: 4

Abilities

Charge: If the Minotaur moves at least 10 ft. straight toward a target and then hits with a gore attack on the same turn, the target takes an extra 9 (2d8) piercing damage and must succeed on a DC 14 Strength saving throw or be pushed 10 ft. away and knocked prone.

Reckless Attack: At the start of its turn, the Minotaur can gain advantage on all melee weapon attack rolls it makes during that turn. Attack rolls against it have advantage until the start of its next turn.

Rage (1/day): As a bonus action, the Minotaur can rage. While raging, it has advantage on Strength checks and saving throws, +3 bonus damage on melee weapon attacks using Strength, and resistance to bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing damage.

Actions

Multiattack: The Minotaur makes one Gore attack and one Greataxe attack.

Gore: Melee Weapon Attack, +9 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 14 (2d8 + 5) piercing damage.

Greataxe: Melee Weapon Attack, +9 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 18 (2d12 + 5) slashing damage.

monsters.name: Minotaur Lich
monsters.subtitle: Medium Monstrosity
monsters.description:
Armor Class: 15

Hit Points: 279

Speed: 35 ft.

STR DEX CON INT WIS CHA
16 (+3) 14 (+2) 16 (+3) 20 (+5) 14 (+2) 16 (+3)

Saving Throws: Con +7, Int +10, Wis +9

Skills: Arcana +18, History +12, Insight +9, Perception +9

Damage Resistances: Cold, Necrotic, Slashing, Bludgeoning, Piercing

Damage Immunities: Fire, Poison

Condition Immunities: Charmed, Exhaustion, Frightened, Paralyzed, Poisoned

Senses: Truesight 120 ft., Passive Perception 19

Languages: All

Challenge Rating: 12

Abilities

Phylactery: If any of its minotaurs are bound to it, when the lich dies, it will take the place of one of the minotaurs.

Charge: If the Minotaur moves at least 10 ft. straight toward a target and then hits it with a gore attack on the same turn, the target takes an extra 9 (2d8) piercing damage and 9 (2d8) necrotic damage and must succeed on a DC 14 Strength saving throw or be pushed 10 ft. away and knocked prone.

Actions

Gore: Melee Weapon Attack, +12 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 15 (2d8 + 6) piercing damage plus 15 (2d8 + 8) necrotic damage.

Horn Blast: Ranged Spell Attack, +11 to hit, range 60 ft., one target. Hit: 27 (4d10 + 5) necrotic damage.

Cast a Spell: Spellcasting ability is Intelligence (spell save DC 19, +11 to hit with spell attacks).

Cantrips (at will): Chill Touch, Fire Bolt, Toll the Dead

1st level (4 slots): Burning Hands, False Life, Magic Missile, Shield

2nd level (3 slots): Darkness, Invisibility, Scorching Ray, Shatter

3rd level (2 slots): Fireball, Fly, Melf's Minute Meteors, Vampiric Touch

4th level (1 slot): Blight, Polymorph

5th level (1 slot): Cloudkill, Telekinesis

Legendary Actions (3 per round)

Cantrip: Cast a cantrip.

Horn Blast (costs 2): Use Horn Blast attack.

Battle Cry (costs 2): All creatures within 30 ft. must make a DC 18 Wisdom saving throw. On a failure, they are frightened until the end of their next turn. Affected creatures may repeat the save at the end of each of their turns.

Disrupt Life (costs 3): Each non-undead, non-minotaur creature within 20 ft. must make a DC 18 Constitution saving throw, taking 21 (6d6) necrotic damage on a failure, or half as much on a success.
